callouts.label: Share Tools
callouts.hint: Two children holding one watering can together.
callouts.description: Healthy friends share materials and make sure both people can participate.
callouts.ap_tip: Ask before taking and return tools when finished.

callouts.label: Listen with Attention
callouts.hint: One child speaks while the other faces them and listens.
callouts.description: Listening shows that a friend’s ideas and feelings matter.
callouts.ap_tip: Eyes, body position, and patient waiting can all show listening.

callouts.label: Welcome Someone New
callouts.hint: A child holds the garden gate open and greets a newcomer.
callouts.description: A friendly welcome helps a new person feel that they belong.
callouts.ap_tip: Offer information without assuming the new person needs everything explained.

callouts.label: Value Different Ideas
callouts.hint: Two children compare different seedlings with equal interest.
callouts.description: Friends can like different plants, games, foods, and ideas and still care for each other.
callouts.ap_tip: Difference is part of every healthy group.

callouts.label: Ask for Space
callouts.hint: A child uses a calm open-hand gesture while a friend pauses.
callouts.description: Healthy boundaries let people say when they need more room or quiet.
callouts.ap_tip: A respectful friend listens and adjusts.

callouts.label: Take Turns
callouts.hint: Two children exchange a garden trowel beside a raised bed.
callouts.description: Taking turns gives each person a fair chance to contribute.
callouts.ap_tip: Waiting can be part of cooperation.

callouts.label: Repair a Mistake
callouts.hint: Two children lift a spilled seed tray together.
callouts.description: Everyone makes mistakes. Healthy friends notice harm, apologize, and help repair it.
callouts.ap_tip: Focus on what can be fixed next.

callouts.label: Adapt So Everyone Joins
callouts.hint: Friends work at an accessible raised bed beside a wheelchair.
callouts.description: Belonging means changing the activity so every person has a meaningful way to join.
callouts.ap_tip: Follow the person’s lead instead of assuming what help they want.

callouts.label: Celebrate a Friend
callouts.hint: Children smile and applaud a friend holding flowers.
callouts.description: Healthy friends can feel happy about another person’s effort and success.
callouts.ap_tip: Celebration does not need a winner.

callouts.label: Check In and Comfort
callouts.hint: A child sits beside a discouraged friend and offers support.
callouts.description: Checking in can sound like “Are you okay?” or “Would you like company?”
callouts.ap_tip: Listen to the answer and seek adult help when needed.
